In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the type of the organisation has an impact on content characteristics associated with audience engagement.
The characteristics of the Twitter posts that attract engagement differ depending on the type of organisation.
Twitter content eliciting audience engagement varies across different organisation types, and that organisations should be cognisant of this when creating content for their Twitter accounts.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the content of a tweet that is likely to elicit engagement depends not only on the type of content, but also on the type of organisation that posts it.
organisations should create content that is more likely to be retweeted and that is more informative, but less likely to be humorous.
organisations should focus on creating posts which are short, have a positive sentiment and contain hashtags, and which are shared by the organisation’s employees.
The main takeaway from our work is that
organisations should be careful when generalising the characteristics of the content associated with engagement, as the type of organisation can have an impact on such characteristics.
organisations need to be aware of the type of posts that are more likely to elicit user engagement, and to tailor their content to the type of organisation they are.
organisations need to consider the type of organisation they are when creating content for social media.
